parsed.detail: You held your usual routine nicely this week, balancing four sessions without letting tiredness take over. It is wonderful that your legs felt great on that hill ride with friends. Your watch shows your fitness trend ticking up, which suggests that your steady work may be starting to show. Weeks of steady training add up to more than one big week. You are in a good rhythm where fatigue and fitness are well balanced. From here, you can hold this steady course, gently build a little more time, or take an easier week if you feel like stepping back.
parsed.line: You had a really smooth week, and it is great that your hill ride felt so good. Steady training adds up to much more than a big push, and that regular rhythm may be starting to show.

options.label: Keep this rhythm
options.description: Stay with the same steady volume and mix of sessions next week.

options.label: Add a little time
options.description: Gently nudge your training time up while keeping the effort comfortable.

options.label: Take an easy week
options.description: Dial back the sessions to rest and let the work sink in.
